first_impression.reaction: Intro is short, so fine. It says eight shapes but doesn't tell me which eight, and I had to scroll the headings to find out. The key takeaways are actually useful though, so I kept going.

journey.reaction: Which eight? Just list them here. That's literally what I searched for.

journey.quote: No grading tables, no prices, no rules.
journey.reaction: Honest, I'll give it that. But no prices at all? Even 'this one costs more per carat' would help. I'll have to look elsewhere for that.

journey.quote: GIA says round brilliant and princess cuts suit almost any finger length and shape.
journey.reaction: Good, a straight answer with a real source. This is the kind of thing I screenshot.

journey.quote: In everyday speech, "cut" usually means shape.
journey.reaction: Oh, I didn't know they were different. Useful, and the heading matches my question exactly.

journey.quote: some ovals show a bow-tie, a dark, bow-tie-shaped shadow across the centre.
journey.reaction: I like ovals so I read this one. Never heard of a bow-tie before. That alone makes the page worth bookmarking.

journey.quote: A quick reference to the eight engagement ring shapes on the hand.
journey.reaction: This table is what I actually wanted on the train. Why is it after all eight sections? Put it right under the takeaways.

unanswered_questions: When was this written or last updated? Is it still true in 2026?
Which shapes cost more or less for the same size?
Which shapes are popular right now?

turn_offs_found.why: The list of shapes, the actual answer to my search, isn't in the first 100 words. Cushion and radiant don't appear until way down the page.
The scannable summary sits below eight long sections and a lot of photos. On my phone that's a lot of scrolling to reach the bit I wanted.

would_share_with: My boyfriend, with the comparison table screenshotted
A friend who keeps saying she wants an oval

cta_reaction.quote: You can [talk to a Wedded Concierge about a proposal or wedding abroad](/wonderland-concierge?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=engagement-ring-cuts&utm_content=bridge).
cta_reaction.why: I'm still choosing a ring shape. Planning a wedding abroad is way down the track. I'd tap the diamond buying guide link instead, that's my next question.

top_3_changes: Name all eight shapes in the intro or first key takeaway (round brilliant, oval, emerald, cushion, princess, pear, marquise, radiant) so the answer is in the first 100 words.
Move the 'Engagement ring cuts compared' table up, straight after the key takeaways.
Add a 'last updated' date so I know it's current.

checks.check: Every journey point and turn-off has an exact quote from the draft
Stayed in character as Priya (search visitor, phone, wants fast answer)
No invented brand facts; missing info listed in unanswered_questions
HTML comments and fact markers treated as invisible
